_meta.adr: ADR-044 unified-case — subsidy applications fold into the unified case model as the 'subsidie' caseType (seeded in lib/Settings/bezwaar_seed_data.json, uuid b3c1a000-0000-4000-a000-0000000005ab). The bespoke subsidieAanvraag index is replaced by a Cases index pre-filtered to that caseType. subsidieAanvraag remains a SUPPORTING schema linked to the case (case.$ref via subsidieAanvraag.case) carrying the subsidy-specific detail (regeling, requested/granted amount, begroting, beschikking); the case carries the common workflow/status. subsidieRegeling stays a config register surfaced under settings. The SubsidieDetail route + subsidieAanvraag schema stay registered for deep links to the linked detail data.
_meta.data-model-decision: Option (b) — linked detail schema. subsidieAanvraag already declares a `case` property ($ref:case, onDelete:SET_NULL), so subsidy cases use the generic `case` workflow while subsidy-specific fields live on the linked subsidieAanvraag record. The `case` schema is NOT bloated with subsidy-only properties.

config._note: SUBSIDY-APPLICATION archetype (subsidieAanvraag). Per ADR-044 the common workflow/status lives on a unified `case` (caseType=subsidie) shown by CaseDetail; subsidieAanvraag is the linked schema holding subsidy-specific data reached by deep link. It declares NO comms linkedTypes, so no files/notes/contacts/calendar leaves — those live on the parent case. The Data widget carries the application and its budget/applicant fields (aanvraagnummer, subsidieregeling, aangevraagdBedrag, begroting, cofinancieringList, projectStartdatum/Einddatum, aanvragerKvkRef, aanvragerBsnRef, behandelaar) and a Related panel links the parent case, the scheme and the handler. Its genuine children — assessments (subsidieBeoordeling), decisions (subsidieBeschikking) and executions (subsidieUitvoering), all keyed subsidieaanvraag=@objectId — are FK-scoped object-lists (these were previously mis-modelled as case-scoped tabs that never matched a subsidieAanvraag id). ADR-062 round 2: the deprecated header summaryAggregates moved into an in-grid stats-block top-right (decision/execution counts), stacked over the Related panel to close the lead row against the 12-field data widget (8x6 = 4x3+4x3); child lists carry tailored emptyText. lifecycleActions drive the status (ontvangen → … → verleend/afgewezen). Audit history is a sidebar tab.
